steps: CREATE QUEUE CARDINALITY_REQUESTS ( ID BIGINT NOT NULL , LOOKUP TEXT NOT NULL , REJECT BOOLEAN NOT NULL ) WITH ( LEASE_DURATION = '30s' , MAX_LEASE_DURATION = '30s' )
CREATE TABLE CARDINALITY_ROWS ( ID BIGINT PRIMARY KEY , LOOKUP TEXT NOT NULL , NOTE TEXT )
CREATE STREAM CARDINALITY_EVENTS ( ID BIGINT NOT NULL , PRESENCE TEXT NOT NULL , NOTE TEXT )

CREATE DATAFLOW CARDINALITY_ROUTE FROM QUEUE CARDINALITY_REQUESTS AS "__t$1_request" AS BEGIN BEGIN ATOMIC LET "__t$2_found" = SELECT NOTE FROM CARDINALITY_ROWS WHERE LOOKUP = "__t$1_request" . LOOKUP ; REQUIRE "__t$2_found" IS NOT NULL ELSE 'ExpectedOneRow'; LET "__t$3_found" = "__t$2_found" ; PRODUCE INTO CARDINALITY_EVENTS VALUES ( "__t$1_request" . ID , 'present' , "__t$3_found" . NOTE ) ; REQUIRE NOT "__t$1_request" . REJECT ELSE 'LateRefusal' ; END ; END
AUTHORIZE DATAFLOW CARDINALITY_ROUTE AS ROLE CURRENT_ROLE
CONSUME ID , PRESENCE , NOTE FROM CARDINALITY_EVENTS
